name: reachinbox-scheduler
description: ReachInbox Email Scheduler - Production-quality full-stack email scheduling application

scripts.showcase: node scripts/ensure-showcase-db.js && cross-env SHOWCASE_MODE=true concurrently "npm run showcase:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.showcase:api: cross-env SHOWCASE_MODE=true DATABASE_URL="file:./showcase.db" npm run dev --workspace=apps/api
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace=apps/api" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/worker" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/web"
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start --workspace=apps/api" "npm run start --workspace=apps/worker" "npm run start --workspace=apps/web"
scripts.setup: npm install && docker compose up -d && sleep 20 && npm run db:migrate:deploy
